messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] Mailing List Changes
messages.body_plain:
FSU is making a mail change which will have the following effects:

For current students @my.fsu.edu will be changed to @fsu.edu.

Any Alumni who are receiving these messages through their @my.fsu.edu accounts, feel free to subscribe using a different method.  (We love having our Alumni correspond with us.  Feel free to post your job listings, and let us know if you want to come and give a talk, either in person, or via Zoom).

A couple of different ways you can update your subscription:

1) Visit https://lists.fsu.edu/mailman/listinfo/epls-r-users and fill out the form there.

2) Send a message to epls-r-users-request at lists.fsu.edu<mailto:epls-r-users-request at lists.fsu.edu> with the following lines:

subscribe xxx at fsu.edu<mailto:xxx at fsu.edu>

unsubscribe xxx at my.fsu.edu<mailto:xxx at my.fsu.edu>

end

3) Or email me and I'll take care of it (eventually).

Thanks for being part of the R group in the past, and I hope you will continue.
